subject.title: feat: carry Featured state into Control

question: Must hosted Featured authority be capability-gated for independent upgrade safety, or may this consumer depend on a coordinated producer-first deployment?
rationale: The deployed feed lacks the new field, so rollout ordering and legacy snapshot behavior determine whether existing Featured entries disappear during an upgrade.

options.title: Capability-gate authority
options.body: Preserve bundled Featured state for legacy feeds and enable hosted authority only when the feed explicitly advertises complete Featured curation.

options.title: Require producer-first rollout
options.body: Accept the implicit dependency but land and release this consumer only after production feeds and snapshots contain complete explicit Featured values.

options.title: Pause consumer rollout
options.body: Keep bundled curation authoritative until the producer contract and independent upgrade behavior are formally versioned.

recommendation.title: Capability-gate authority
recommendation.body: Preserve bundled Featured state for legacy feeds and enable hosted authority only when the feed explicitly advertises complete Featured curation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects the central plugin catalog contract and coordinated Control rollout.
